_readme: Pre-calibrated advance widths for iMessage text art. Measured 2026-09-27 via CoreText on macOS (SF Pro Text 17pt base, system font cascade). Units are em. This table ships calibrated: you do not need to measure anything to use the library.

meta.method: CoreText CTRunGetAdvances with font cascade, SFProText-Regular 17pt base
meta.note: Fullwidth forms (U+FF00-U+FFEF) and U+3000 are 1em by CJK typographic definition; measurement confirmed 17.0pt at 17pt size on Apple platforms. Only emoji and fractional spacers need explicit entries.
